subtitle: Master lead guitar through analysis of great solos and understanding of melodic construction.

columns.title: Tell a Story
columns.text: Great lead guitar doesn't just play notes—it tells a musical story through melodic phrases, tension, and resolution.

columns.title: Theory in Action
columns.text: Understanding scales, chord tones, and harmonic function allows you to play meaningful melodies that support the song.

topics.title: Scale Application
topics.description: Learn how to choose and apply scales over chord progressions in real songs for melodic lead playing.
topics.theory: Scale-chord relationships, modal interchange, key centers

topics.title: Phrasing & Expression
topics.description: Develop musical phrasing using bends, vibrato, and timing to create expressive lead guitar lines.
topics.theory: Musical phrases, rhythmic displacement, expression techniques

topics.title: Solo Construction
topics.description: Understand how to build compelling solos using motivic development, tension, and resolution.
topics.theory: Motivic development, harmonic tension, structural analysis

topics.title: Melodic Intervals
topics.description: Master the use of intervals to create memorable melodies and understand their emotional impact.
topics.theory: Interval theory, melodic motion, harmonic intervals

topics.title: Blues Lead Techniques
topics.description: Learn essential blues lead techniques including bending, call-and-response, and blues scale application.
topics.theory: Blues scales, chord-tone targeting, blues harmony

topics.title: Rock Lead Guitar
topics.description: Master rock lead techniques including power chord melodies, pentatonic applications, and aggressive phrasing.
topics.theory: Pentatonic scales, power chord harmony, rock phrasing

topics.title: Jazz Lead Concepts
topics.description: Explore jazz lead guitar through chord substitutions, altered scales, and sophisticated harmonic concepts.
topics.theory: Altered scales, chord extensions, jazz harmony

topics.title: Country Lead Techniques
topics.description: Learn country lead guitar including chicken picking, hybrid picking, and Telecaster-style phrasing.
topics.theory: Major pentatonic, hybrid picking, country harmony

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: Study the chord progression and identify key centers, chord tones, and available scales.

steps.title: Phrase
steps.description: Create short musical phrases that outline the harmony and express the song's emotion.

steps.title: Develop
steps.description: Build longer passages by connecting phrases and creating motivic development throughout the solo.

steps.title: Express
steps.description: Add expression through bending, vibrato, and dynamics to make the solo uniquely yours.

columns.title: Harmonic Foundation:
columns.text: Built over Bm-A-G-Em progression using B minor pentatonic as the primary scale choice.

columns.title: Phrasing Technique:
columns.text: Uses space, bends, and vibrato to create emotional expression rather than speed or complexity.

columns.title: Structural Elements:
columns.text: Builds from simple motifs to complex passages, creating a narrative arc throughout the solo.

columns.title: Learn the Harmony:
columns.text: Before playing lead, understand the chord progression thoroughly. Play the chords, identify the key, and find chord tones on the fretboard.

columns.title: Sing Your Ideas:
columns.text: If you can't sing a melody, it's probably not memorable. Practice singing melodic ideas before playing them on guitar.

nextSteps.title: 🚀 Begin Your Lead Journey
nextSteps.description: Start with scale application to understand the theoretical foundation, then develop your phrasing and expression.
